content.name: StockAgent
content.tagline: Agentic Commerce for FMCG Distributors — autonomous stock monitoring and supplier payments via PayPal
content.hackathon: PayPal AI Hackathon — Build What's Next

content.mission: Technology Consulting and Engineering — Discover. Architect. Build. Operate.

layers.name: Data Source
layers.tech: SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod) — inventory, recipients, dispatches, invoices

layers.name: Trigger Layer
layers.tech: AWS EventBridge fires when stock < threshold (prod) / auto-scan on startup (dev)

layers.name: Primary Agent
layers.tech: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore orchestrates full flow

layers.name: Sub-Agents
layers.tech: Stock Sub-Agent (checks levels), Order Sub-Agent (selects supplier, calculates cost), Compliance Sub-Agent (checks for duplicate open orders)

layers.name: Approval Gateway
layers.tech: Dashboard APPROVE button (now) → WhatsApp via Twilio (pending)

layers.name: MCP Server
layers.tech: Model Context Protocol server wrapping PayPal Payouts + Invoicing APIs — runs in MOCK mode without keys

layers.name: Payment Execution
layers.tech: PayPal Payouts API (supplier payments) + PayPal Invoicing API (recipient billing)

layers.name: Infra
layers.tech: Node.js (no-Docker local) / AWS Lambda + ECS Fargate (prod)

tables: products — sku, stock levels, reorder threshold, preferred_supplier
recipients — name, type, color, initials, stocking_frequency, stocking_day, payment_terms, credit_limit
dispatches — recipient→product delivery records, links to invoice
stock_events — audit log of all dispatch/restock/adjustment events
reorder_cycles — agent-created procurement orders with approval and PayPal transaction tracking

content.note: Each recipient has a colour-coded avatar (color + initials), full dispatch history, invoice trail, and stocking schedule. This feeds the invoicing layer.

content.key_rule: Projects must meaningfully use both PayPal AND AI — no prescribed stack or domain required
content.agentic_commerce_definition: An AI agent that autonomously initiates, manages, or completes a commercial transaction without a human clicking confirm at each step
content.our_differentiator: The AWS Agentic AI Supply Chain reference architecture builds agents that recommend and alert. StockAgent adds the layer that acts and pays — closing the loop from insight to execution via PayPal.

content.recommendation: Use Claude Haiku for hackathon, Sonnet for production. Set AWS billing alert at $50.

content.roi: Platform costs KES 3,000/month. Saves KES 9,000/month in labour. 3x ROI before counting stockouts prevented.
